title: アニメーション制作演習
subtitle: Animated-Movie Production
teachers:
URA Masahiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students learn the animation principle and how to create and express animations based on the principle.
Specifically, they learn about apparent motion expressions and time-lapse animations on paper media that can be easily produce.
Next, students learn 3DCG animation technique based on digital technology.
Students will acquire basic skills in animation production.
advice:
In the first half, students create a stop-motion animation to understand the principles of animation.
Students create animations that express movements by connecting frames taken with a digital camera.
In the second half, students　create 3DCG animation.

In order to create original animations, it is recommended that students watched many animations from the creator's point of view, such as “expression methods”, “screen composition”, and “color and form”.
requiredKnowledge:
Freehand drawing skills is required.
CG production experience using 3DCG software　such as MAYA is required.
It is preferable that image processing software (Photoshop etc.) can be used.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the animation principle.
Be able to create stop-motion animation.
Be able to create CG digital animation.
